metaDescription: Cairn Terrier vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Cairn Terrier boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Cairn Terriers: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Cairn Terrier series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class small does not invent new viruses for the Cairn Terrier, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag legg-calve-perthes risk at Cairn Terrier vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Cairn Terrier series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Cairn Terrier misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Cairn Terrier series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Cairn Terrier is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Cairn Terrier away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Cairn Terrier due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Cairn Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Cairn Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Cairn Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Cairn Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as allergies, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
